title.zh: 工业场所占用人或业主须委任消防安全经理
title.en: Occupier Or Owner of Industrial Premises to Appoint Fire Safety Managers

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Fire Safety Act
(Chapter 109A, Section 22(1))
Occupier or Owner of Industrial Premises
to Appoint Fire Safety Managers
N 3
G.N. No. S 285/1997
REVISED EDITION 1998
(15th June 1998)
[15th June 1997]
The Minister for Home Affairs has specified that the premises occupied or owned by the companies set out in the Schedule shall be premises in respect of which the owner or occupier is required to appoint a fire safety manager.
